name: Onii-chan Daisuki! ~Love? Or Like?~
original_name: おにいちゃん だぁいすき！～LOVE？ or LIKE？～
source:
Main character used to live together with cute twin sisters. This summer sisters will be spending at his home again while parents are away. He looks forward to hearing "Onii-chan" and playing just like kids again. But girls have grown up, and atmosphere has changed as well.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公过去曾与一对可爱的双胞胎姐妹共同生活。今年夏天，父母不在期间，姐妹俩将再次到他家度过假期。他期待着重新听见那声“哥哥”，像儿时一样与她们玩耍。然而，少女们已经长大，彼此之间的氛围也发生了变化。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
